name: today-mod
description: /today: the day's agenda for Claude and for you. Calendar events, E3 deadlines and Reminders are read through the zyx utils scripts, shown as one line above the prompt with a countdown to the next event, and handed to Claude as a context block so it knows your day.

scriptsDir.title: utils scripts directory
scriptsDir.description: Where the zyx utils scripts live (calendar.py, reminders.py, e3p.py). Defaults to the iCloud clone of zyx1121/plugin.

refreshMs.title: Refresh interval
refreshMs.description: Milliseconds between re-reads of the three sources. 300000 (5 minutes) by default; 60000 at the least.

dueDays.title: E3 deadline window
dueDays.description: Days ahead to list E3 deadlines. 7 by default.

remindersList.title: Reminders list
remindersList.description: The Reminders list to read. TODO by default.

showOnStart.title: Show on start
showOnStart.description: Show the line as soon as an interactive session starts. The last /today on|off choice, once made, wins over this.
